messages:
rita: FYI - qbuild rollout for engine 3.2.2-rc on gpu-pool-west triggered noticeable p99 latency spikes on long-sequence gen (>1024). Happening after the q4 fallback optimizer was enabled in rc-nightly.

marco: do we have repro on staging or just production canaries?

alisha: repro'd on staging with runcase long_seq_v2. p99 went from 420ms -> 980ms on some T4 hosts; A100 less affected but still a bump.

perfbot: attached perf summary:
- baseline engine:3.2.1 p99=430ms
- engine:3.2.2-rc qbuild(q4_fallback=true) p99=960ms
- tokens/s per-worker -18% on T4; -5% on A100

ci-bot: builds: rc-3.2.2-2026-03-25T01:10Z (q4_fallback=true)
ci-bot: smoke status: staging long_seq_v2 FAILED (p99 threshold exceeded)

rita: ok we should pause the night slice. Marco, can you pin the staging and canary pools back to 3.2.1 and open a revert PR?

marco: requesting deploy-bot: `/deploy pin canary-pool engine:3.2.1 --sticky-ttl 8h --scope=canaries`
deploy-bot: @marco requested: apply sticky pin on canary-pool -> engine:3.2.1. Pin applied ✅ at 2026-03-25T02:00Z

marco: creating revert PR for the q4_fallback flag, tag: revert/q4-fallback-commit b2d9e44. Also starting a targeted bisect across qbuild commits.

qa: quick note - QA saw an increase in RLHF sampling variance in the same timeframe. Might be related to scheduling changes.

ops: observed increased backpressure on the scheduling queue when multiple long-seq requests arrive simultaneously; autoscaler spin-up lagged 30s in one instance.

rita: decision: block the wider rollout. We'll keep canaries pinned and run an A/B with a small controlled slice of 3% later tonight on a thermally-instrumented cluster after revert. If revert fixes, proceed with 10% slice and p99 + queue-depth gates.

perfbot: bisect outcome: regression introduced by commit b2d9e44 - scheduler path changes interacting with q4 reorder heuristics. Reproducer attached: run `./tools/run_long_seq.sh --force-single-stream` reproduces p99 spike.

marco: PR ready: revert b2d9e44 in branch revert/q4-fallback. Kicking quick qbuild: `/ci build --short revert/q4-fallback`

ci-bot: quick-qbuild started. ETA ~14m. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/23456

alisha: plan for rollout gates:
- Preflight smoke on pinned canaries for 45m with p99 <= 1.15x baseline AND tokens/s degradation < 7%
- Night slice rollout: 3% initial, monitor 30m, ramp to 15% if green
- Auto-unpin disabled; unpin requires ops approval and docs/customer-notify done

docs: I'll draft customer-facing note and internal release note. Short message saying "we paused rollouts due to p99 regression on long sequences; fix deployed to canaries; we will update when we unpin."

ci-bot: quick-qbuild succeeded. Artifact: engine:3.2.2-rc-revert-q4-2026-03-25T02:20Z

perfbot: smoke on pinned canaries (revert build) shows p99 stable at 440ms over 50m. tokens/s within 3% of baseline.

rita: checklist to unpin trial slice: [1] merged revert PR, [2] smoke run >=45m on canaries green, [3] A/B 3% slice prepared with telemetry hooks, [4] docs + customer note in draft.

marco: merged revert PR and promoted quick-qbuild to canary-artifact. Preparing canary slice job: `/deploy rollout --slice 3% --artifact engine:3.2.2-rc-revert-q4 --gate p99,queue-depth --gate-duration 30m`

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled. Note: canary-pool remains pinned until ops approves unpin for the A/B slice. Use `/deploy request-unpin canary-pool --for=ab-slice-3pct` to start approval.

ops: approving A/B slice request if perfbot shows no regressions for the first 30m. We'll also enable extra tracing on the scheduler path for that slice.

rita: thanks all. Leave thread open until the 3% slice finishes. If anything spikes, we revert to engine:3.2.1 immediately and keep canaries pinned.

alisha: standing by for the 30m window. I'll post a summary when complete.

perfbot: 30m A/B result: no p99 spike for revert build in 3% slice; queue-depth stable. Recommendation: continue ramp to 15% with standard gates.

rita: ramping to 15% now. Docs sending customer note shortly. Closing follow-ups to #release-postmortem for root-cause deeper dive.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 15% initiated. Reminder: auto-unpin disabled. Manual approval required to remove sticky pin from canary-pool.
